overview: Thread = lightweight process. User-level vs kernel-level threads, kya shared hai kya nahi, aur multithreaded code ka result.
coreConcept: Threads of a process share code, data (globals), heap, open files, address space; each has its own stack, registers, program counter.
hinglishExplanation: Thread process ke andar chalne wala chhota execution unit hai. Memory (heap, globals) share hoti hai, lekin har thread ka apna stack aur registers hote hain. User-level threads ka context switch tez, par ek blocked to sab blocked. Kernel threads OS schedule karta hai.
formalDefinition: Threads of a process share code, data (globals), heap, open files, address space; each has its own stack, registers, program counter.
importantProperties: Shared: code, global data, heap, files, address space, signal handlers.
Private: stack, registers, PC, thread id.
User-level thread switch fast (no kernel), but one blocking call blocks the entire process.
Kernel threads: true parallelism on multiprocessors, switch slower.
Thread ke liye chhota data structure => 'light weight'.
commonPitfalls: Program counter/stack ko shared maan lena.
User threads ko multiple cores par parallel maan lena.
standardTechniques: Shared vs private ki list yaad rakho.
Race condition ke liye shared variable dhundo.
